school_name: The University of Texas at Dallas

boards.school_name: The University of Texas at Dallas
boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten no-admission activities and cultural stops at UT Dallas or nearby Richardson, each supported by a direct public source.

cards.entity_name: Crow Museum of Asian Art at UT Dallas
cards.title: Walk the Crow Museum galleries
cards.subtitle: Edith and Peter O’Donnell Jr. Athenaeum, UT Dallas
cards.notes: Meet in the Athenaeum and move through the Crow Museum’s galleries together; keep the visit focused on the art and outdoor sculpture garden.
cards.short_summary: A free public museum visit on the UT Dallas campus.
cards.evidence_claim: UT Dallas states that the Crow Museum and UT Dallas Art Museums are free and open to the public Tuesday through Sunday.
cards.source_title: UTD Celebrates Grand Opening of New Arts Cornerstone on Campus
cards.access_notes: Free public access Tuesday through Sunday; confirm current museum hours before visiting.

cards.title: Browse the UT Dallas Art Museums
cards.subtitle: Edith and Peter O’Donnell Jr. Athenaeum, UT Dallas
cards.notes: Use the Athenaeum as a low-key meet-up point, then take time with the university art galleries and compare one work each before leaving.
cards.short_summary: Free public art viewing in UT Dallas’ cultural gateway.
cards.evidence_claim: UT Dallas states that the UT Dallas Art Museums and Crow Museum are free and open to the public Tuesday through Sunday.
cards.source_title: UTD Celebrates Grand Opening of New Arts Cornerstone on Campus
cards.access_notes: Free public access Tuesday through Sunday; check current gallery information before going.

cards.title: Take a self-guided campus walk
cards.subtitle: UT Dallas campus, Richardson
cards.notes: Open the university’s interactive map, choose a few named buildings or outdoor stops, and turn the route into a walk-and-talk with friends.
cards.short_summary: A map-led way to explore named UTD destinations at your own pace.
cards.evidence_claim: UT Dallas provides a self-guided campus tour through its interactive campus map with walking directions.
cards.source_title: Virtual Tours - Office of Admission and Enrollment
cards.access_notes: The online self-guided tour requires no admission or purchase; follow campus rules and any posted building-access restrictions.

cards.title: Attend the Texas Guitar Competition and Festival
cards.subtitle: UT Dallas, Richardson
cards.notes: When the festival returns, go with a friend to hear classical-guitar performances and use the event schedule to choose a concert or master class.
cards.short_summary: A free UT Dallas-hosted classical-guitar festival event.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Richardson lists the 2026 Texas Guitar Competition and Festival at UT Dallas with free admission.
cards.access_notes: The cited 2026 program listed free admission; future dates and programming should be confirmed before attending.

cards.entity_name: Center for Children and Families Spring Lecture Series
cards.title: Go to a CCF research lecture
cards.subtitle: Callier Center Richardson Addition, UT Dallas
cards.notes: Check the lecture topic, bring a classmate, and arrive ready to discuss one idea afterward; the series is presented in person and online.
cards.short_summary: A public developmental-science lecture series connected to UT Dallas.
cards.evidence_claim: The Center for Children and Families’ Margaret Tresch Owen Lecture Series states that all lectures are free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: CCF Spring Lecture Series: The Origins of Talking about the Unseen
cards.access_notes: The series page says lectures are free and open to the public; verify the next lecture’s date, room, and attendance format.

cards.entity_name: Game On: Board Games in the Library
cards.title: Play Game On board games
cards.subtitle: Spring Creek Room, Richardson Public Library
cards.notes: Meet in the Spring Creek Room for a librarian-led game session; choose a game that fits the group and leave time to learn the rules together.
cards.short_summary: A free, librarian-led board-game hang for adults and teens.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Richardson lists Game On: Board Games in the Library for adults and teens with free admission.
cards.access_notes: The cited session was free; check the library calendar for the next offering and any registration details.

cards.title: Bring a question to Drop-In Tech Help
cards.subtitle: Richardson Public Library
cards.notes: Pair up on a phone, tablet, e-reader, or research question and use the short librarian session to get unstuck before continuing your study hang.
cards.short_summary: A free walk-in library help session for everyday tech questions.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Richardson describes Drop-In Tech Help at Richardson Public Library as free admission.
cards.access_notes: The cited program is free; confirm the current Thursday schedule with the library before making a trip.

cards.entity_name: Forrest and Virginia Green Mezzanine Gallery
cards.title: See an exhibit at the Green Mezzanine Gallery
cards.subtitle: Eisemann Center, Richardson
cards.notes: Take the elevator or stairs to the upper-level gallery, spend a few minutes with the current exhibition, and compare favorite pieces afterward.
cards.short_summary: A free gallery stop in the Eisemann Center lobby.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Richardson lists the Forrest and Virginia Green Mezzanine Gallery exhibition with free admission and regular viewing hours.
cards.access_notes: The cited gallery listing gave free admission and stated Monday-Saturday viewing hours; verify the current exhibition and hours.

cards.title: Catch a CityLine LIVE set
cards.subtitle: CityLine Plaza, Richardson
cards.notes: Meet at the plaza for the scheduled outdoor music set and use the open public area for a no-purchase concert hang; bring water if needed.
cards.short_summary: A free outdoor live-music series at CityLine Plaza.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Richardson lists CityLine LIVE featuring Chant Duplantier at CityLine Plaza with free admission.
cards.access_notes: The cited CityLine LIVE date had free admission; check the organizer’s current schedule before going.

cards.title: Walk a round at Breckinridge Disc Golf Course
cards.subtitle: Breckinridge Park, Richardson
cards.notes: Bring your own discs, start near Parking Lot C, and play a relaxed round while keeping clear of other park users and the marked course flow.
cards.short_summary: A free public disc-golf course in Breckinridge Park.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Richardson lists the Breckinridge Disc Golf Course at Breckinridge Park with free admission and daily sunrise-to-sunset access.
cards.access_notes: The City listing states free admission and sunrise-to-sunset access; bring your own equipment and observe posted park rules.
